history: Guiyang got its name from its bamboo; karst hills make it 'a city within mountains, mountains within a city'. Jiaxiu Tower has stood on the Nanming River for 400 years; Qingyan Ancient Town keeps its Ming-Qing look. Its cool climate made it a pioneer of China's big-data industry — 'the Data Valley of China'.
importance: Capital of Guizhou · Big-data hub city
foods: Noodles in red oil with blood curd and crispy bits — the king of Guiyang breakfast.
Thin wraps rolled with a dozen veggie strips, dipped in sour soup.
Kaili red sour soup with rice-paddy fish — appetizing and fresh.
Beef rice noodles in clear broth, smooth and springy.
Lei's tofu balls — crispy outside, hollow inside, dipped in herb water.
Charcoal-grilled tofu bursting with juice, with chili dip — a romantic name.
The soul cold-dish of Guizhou people.
Braised 'zhuangyuan' pork trotter, soft and fragrant.
scenes: A 400-year-old tower on Turtle Rock in the Nanming River.
Wild macaques in the city park and the incense of Hongfu Temple.
Ming-Qing garrison town with stone-paved lanes.
Highland flower sea and wetland by the Huaxi River.
Karst caves, waterfalls and stone bonsai landscapes.
A unique nine-corner three-story pagoda building.
Yelang culture and Miao silver ornaments.
